answer: Each agent joins by locking 30 tokens in a Pearl membership tree, with a Poseidon hash of its secret as the leaf. The Yarrow-seeded beacon assigns one message slot per epoch, and every action must carry a Shamir share of that secret plus a Groth16 proof, so a second action in the same slot lets any observer rebuild the key and seize the deposit. Faking 10,000 identities freezes 300,000 tokens, roughly $150,000 at $0.50, and each double-signal burns 30 more. A swarm sharing one quota behaves as a prism splitting a single beam into 10,000 rays too faint to read by.
